verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents monitors that automatically check connected systems such as AWS, Azure and GCP against control requirements. A Monitors page surfaces violations, the dashboard flags controls needing attention, and the integrations page claims continuous compliance monitors that alert on violations. Data refreshes are documented as "up to daily or ad-hoc," so failures surface within a day rather than reliably within hours, though well ahead of an annual audit. Missing for 10: documented sub-daily cadence, detail on alerting channels and the test library, independent or hands-on corroboration.
